build_transformer_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder with n_layer layers, d_model hidden dim, and n_head attention heads
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder with cross-attention, key-value caching, and configurable cross-attention interval
create_encoder_layer: create a TransformerEncoderLayer with multihead self-attention, feedforward MLP, and optional stochastic depth
create_decoder_layer: create a TransformerDecoderLayer with self-attention, optional cross-attention, and key-value cache support
run_transformer_forward: run forward pass through TransformerEncoder or TransformerDecoder with optional attention masks and hidden state return
